# Quantus Miner (quantus.com)

> A high-performance external miner for the Quantus Network, run from one command across CPU, GPU, or both.

This is a Rust workspace that builds `quantus-miner`, a service that connects to a Quantus Network node over a QUIC protocol, receives mining jobs, and returns proof-of-work results. It supports CPU-only, GPU-only, and hybrid CPU+GPU mining, with cross-platform GPU acceleration via WGPU (Metal on macOS, Vulkan/OpenGL on Linux, DirectX 12/Vulkan on Windows) and optional Prometheus metrics.

It is for people running or testing Quantus Network mining, including anyone speedrunning testnet QUAN. This repo is Adam's working fork of the upstream Quantus-Network miner: it is engine code and a CLI, not a website. There is no hosted app here, you build and run the binary yourself.

## Key links
- [Home](https://quantus.com/): landing for the Quantus Network project this miner serves.
- [README](https://github.com/adamtpang/quantus.com/blob/main/README.md): build, run, GPU setup, Docker, and benchmarking instructions.
- [External miner protocol](https://github.com/adamtpang/quantus.com/blob/main/EXTERNAL_MINER_PROTOCOL.md): the QUIC-based NewJob/JobResult message spec.
- [Upstream project](https://github.com/Quantus-Network/quantus-miner): the canonical Quantus Network miner this fork tracks.
